items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Yeah. And we worked a lot of other jobs together after that.

ctx.x: Yeah. And we worked a lot of other jobs together after that.
Years later or that same 1930s or 40s with Toots?

Years later, but that was before I went to the service. Right. That was before I went to the service. And when I got out of the service, I went back to school. And I was working at a club they called Mary's Tavern on a magazine near Jackson Avenue. Nice.
